# `cube::Zone`

[Game reference](../README.md) › [world](../world.md) › `cube::Zone`

- **Kind:** class
- **Status:** verified (source: kyubu)
- **Builds:** Cube.exe, Server.exe, Server.exe only
- **C:** `cube_Zone` in `cubeworld/types.h`
- **Lua:** `cubeworld.cast("cube_Zone", address)`
- **Evidence:** `rtti:cube::Zone`, `xref:cube::World::getBlock`

the level fields and the block columns are mapped. generateZone copies 16 bytes of the zone's region tile (tile+0x18 to +0x27) to +0x78 to +0x87 (0x51A721 to 0x51A740)
